native.method: decoded-frame inspection plus passthrough RGB scan of every decoded frame at 320x180, panel band x 90-230 y 4-55
native.note: Host panel is the measurement. Resume after hold is not onset. First WinError 5 is not FROZEN.

finshield.method: passthrough RGB crop of the Arena panel region, 2448 decoded frames aligned 1:1 with timestamps
finshield.note: Flicker hits resumed with advancing LIVE ticks. They are not a stalled-tick 10-second FROZEN hold. OpenProcess text is not the desktop measurement.
